mechanism_narrative: A low effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195) signal an economic transition to monetary tightening, causing negative equity returns as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 195, or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.0% and housing starts decline > 1.0%), a drop in housing activity (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% AND HOUST decline > 1.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when late-cycle regime conditions hold and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) reflect robust consumer demand for residential construction, signaling strong economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2000 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index) indicates weakening manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.3% monthly) signals a virtuous cycle of strong labor markets and consumer spending, generating positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% AND RSAFS growth rate > 0.3%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS growth rates exceed thresholds, or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary monetary tightening cycle (CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), aggressive rate hikes to combat inflation increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 2010-2011 is below 0.03.
